title: feat: website page views and source attribution in product analytics
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Added website page-view analytics through Enter’s POST /api/analytics/website-page-view route and the existing Tinybird product_event table. The route accepts requests only from the sibling website origin and records allowlisted pages as website_page_viewed, separate from Enter’s funnels. The website sends one beacon per known page view, without a cookie or visitor identifier; unknown pages and browsers without sendBeacon are skipped. Referrer, UTM and ref source data is kept in sessionStorage and passed through Enter links so traffic_sources can attribute signups and purchases. Enter now reads source data at module load, before redirects can discard UTM parameters; links retain noopener but no longer use noreferrer. The Cloudflare traffic sync now includes /subprocessors. Privacy policy §7 was extended to cover the website and needs operator review.

image.prompt: A cozy pixel art garden path leads from a pollinations.ai website screen to an Enter terminal, with small flower markers for page views and a friendly CRT monitor robot counting them; lime green (#ecf874) glows against warm cream, mint and peach pastels with dark purple (#110518) outlines. Polli wears a tiny surveyor’s hat and follows the path: the main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, with consistent rounded proportions, strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
